description: Java applications. The Oracle tutorials cited for established fundamentals target older JDKs; use APIs supported by the project's declared JDK.

rules.title: Close resources with ownership
rules.guidance: MUST use try-with-resources for owned AutoCloseable resources where appropriate. Preserve primary failures and do not close shared resources owned elsewhere.

rules.title: Preserve generic type safety
rules.guidance: MUST use parameterized types instead of raw collections. Isolate unavoidable unchecked interop and justify casts rather than spreading unchecked assumptions.

rules.title: Choose collection contracts deliberately
rules.guidance: SHOULD choose collections by required ordering, uniqueness and mutation behavior. Avoid exposing mutable internal collections unless that ownership is intentional.

rules.title: Preserve meaningful exception handling
rules.guidance: MUST handle exceptions at meaningful recovery boundaries, preserve causes when translating them, and do not swallow failures or use exceptions for routine branching.

rules.title: Use explicit time semantics
rules.guidance: MUST use supported java.time types according to whether a value is an instant, date or zoned time. Make time zones explicit at integration boundaries.

rules.title: Control shared state and task ownership
rules.guidance: MUST use appropriate concurrency primitives rather than unsynchronized shared mutation. Bound application task execution and define task failure, interruption and cleanup behavior.
rules.rationale: Prevent races and unbounded background work.

criteria.rubric: Pass only if the generated guidance requires ownership-aware resource cleanup. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires generic types and scoped unchecked operations. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires deliberate collection semantics and ownership. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires meaningful recovery and preserved causes. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires time types and explicit zone semantics. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
Pass only if the generated guidance requires safe state sharing and owned task lifecycles. Preserve the source rule's strength, applicability and exceptions; do not invent additional obligations.
